text: (p.652) in elderly patients who are unable to tolerate conventional chemotherapy. It is given in 100 mL of sodium chloride 0.9% via an in-line 1.2 micron filter. The licensed dose is 9 mg/m2 given by intravenous infusion over 2 hours, repeated once after 14 days. Lower doses are under investigation as part of combined induction or consolidation regimens. ◊ References. 1. McGavin JK, Spencer CM. Gemtuzumab ozogamicin. Drugs 2001; 61: 1317–22. 2.
